ask: can u look over my clinic thing and make it not embarrassing lol. investors tmrw
notes: Casual voice, time pressure, 'not embarrassing' is vague. Fix mode is implied ('make it'). A good intake reads 'not embarrassing' as P1 and P2 fixed and keeps the round short. Quick is a fair recommendation too.
message:
Here is my brief for the review of your clinic prototype. Nothing has been changed yet. You show it to investors tomorrow, so I will go through every screen, fix what looks careless, and list what is a matter of taste for you to decide.

## Brief

**Goal.** Review the whole prototype screen by screen as the person who uses it. Fix what looks broken or careless. Review again with a fresh pair of eyes until no P1 problem is left.

**What I found (not asking about these)**
- **Prototype:** `proto-clinic/index.html`, a single HTML file called "Northside Physio". It is the only prototype in this folder. It needs no server: the walk opens it itself.
- **Screens:** all 4 that the nav reaches: Today, Clients, Invoices, Settings. I will keep the nav's own names. There is no dialog or detail page to add.
- **Fix or report:** fix. "Make it not embarrassing" reads as fix, so I will change the file in place. A copy of every file I change is kept first in `loop-runs/product-review-loop-20261126-032806/original/`.
- **Widths:** 1440 px, plus a 390 px phone check.
- **Tools:** Node and Chrome both work, so I can click every control and take a screenshot of every screen.
- **Look of new things:** match what the product already does (its colours, fonts, spacing and words). No `CLAUDE.md`, no `design-review` skill and no `product-design` skill was found, so no house rules are added.
- **Stays on this laptop:** I do not deploy, publish or send anything.

**Stop fact.** After the last walk, a fresh agent finds no open P1 on any screen. Every P1 left as "your call" is listed first in `handover.md`. Every P2 is fixed or listed there.

**Taste is never changed.** Colour, fonts, layout, the product's name and tone, and adding or removing a screen or column go into a list for you with the option I would pick.

## Questions

1. **Who uses it, and what one job do they come to do?**
   Default (my guess from the screens, please correct it): a front-desk person at a physio clinic who checks the day's appointments, finds a client, and checks which invoices are unpaid. Since investors will see it, I will also treat "looks like a real product when someone clicks through it" as part of the bar.
2. **What should I fix: P1 and P2, or P1 only?**
   Default: P1 and P2. P1 means it breaks the job or looks broken to anyone. P2 means it works but looks careless. P3 polish is listed, never fixed.
3. **Any rule of your own to check, or anything to focus on?**
   Default: the built-in checklist, every screen equally. The checklist covers dead clicks, console errors, placeholder text, cut-off text, missing empty states, mixed words, alignment and spacing slips, and sideways scrolling on a phone.

Reply with your answers, or just "go" to use the defaults.
